cuts.desc: 새벽 차고지 크레인 상승 — 「단지」 공개 / 폐버스 로우앵글 히어로샷 / 지면 실측 — 바퀴 대신 시멘트 블록 / 입주자의 당당한 도착 / 모델하우스 투어 — 버스 통로 / 프리미엄 조망 — 창밖은 철망과 폐버스 / 루프탑 라운지 — 도심 야경 음미 / 입주 성공자의 얼굴 / 키비주얼 — 조명 받은 폐버스와 입주자
cuts.prompt: The first reference image shows Photoreal full-body portrait of a Korean man in his late twenties standing in soft golden morning light. Slightly messy short black hair. The second reference image shows Photoreal wide establishing view of a decommissioned city bus in a gravel bus depot at golden hour. The bus is rusted, paint faded and peeling. Keep the people, wardrobe, and setting identical to the reference images. 0-4s: The camera cranes upward slowly over the chain-link fence, revealing the whole gravel depot. No people in frame. crane up from low, slowly ascending high over the depot, wide lens, warm soft morning light. 4-7s: The camera pushes in very slowly toward the bus while a torn plastic sheet on the roof flutters gently. No people in frame. low angle shot looking up at the bus, slow dolly in, dramatic hero grammar, golden-hour sunlight. 7-10s: The camera glides slowly sideways just above the gravel past the cinder blocks under the wheelless axle, then a single drop of rusty water drips from the wheel arch. No people in frame. ground-level worm's-eye, low tracking shot skimming just above the gravel, traveling sideways, shallow focus. 10-13s: The young man in the worn gray hoodie walks toward the bus folding door with a slow, confident stride, chin held high. hip-level tracking shot, waist-height camera, mild upward perspective, confident stride framing. 13-16s: The young man in the worn gray hoodie strolls down the bus aisle, trailing one hand along the seat backs like a proud homeowner inspecting a penthouse corridor. slow dolly in down the aisle at eye level, warm shafts of window light, luxury walkthrough grammar. 16-20s: The young man in the worn gray hoodie stands at the bus window, gazes out at the chain-link fence, and gives one slow, deeply satisfied nod. medium shot, slow push-in, warm golden-hour backlight through the bus window, long soft shadows. 20-24s: The young man in the worn gray hoodie sits in the folding camp chair on the bus roof and slowly raises a paper cup toward the distant city lights, savoring the moment. wide static shot, slight low angle, rim-lit silhouette against distant city night bokeh. 24-27s: The camera orbits slowly clockwise around the young man in the worn gray hoodie as a faint, proud smile settles across the face. tight close-up, slow orbit clockwise about 20 degrees over 3 seconds, soft key light from the city glow. 27-30s: The young man in the worn gray hoodie stands beside the open folding door and folds both arms with a settled, proud posture, then the camera pulls back slowly to frame the whole spotlit bus. slow dolly out to a wide low-angle hero frame, locked at the end, fixed key-visual grammar. Sound: Soft morning birdsong, faint distant city hum, light wind through a wire fence; Wind, plastic sheet flapping softly, a single low reverberant swell of air tone; Gravel crunch under wind, one clear water drip, metal ticking as it warms in the sun; Unhurried footsteps on gravel, keys jingling once, morning ambience; Creaking floor panels at each step, muffled traffic outside, a soft seat spring squeak; Wind rattling the loose window frame lightly, distant crow call, warm room tone; Night crickets, far-off city rumble, one gentle gust of wind; Hushed night ambience, fabric rustle as the chair shifts once; Gentle wind, one distant car horn, a low warm tonal swell that stops clean at the end. No music.
